assignments.value:
={{
(() => {
  const last = $json.body.leads[0]?.last_conversion?.content || {};
  const first = $json.body.leads[0]?.first_conversion?.content || {};

  const isempresa_demoHub =
    (last.conversion_identifier || '').toLowerCase().includes('empresa_demohub') ||
    (last.event_identifier || '').toLowerCase().includes('empresa_demohub') ||
    (last.identificador || '').toLowerCase().includes('empresa_demohub') ||
    (last.conversion_url || '').toLowerCase().includes('empresa_demohub') ||
    (first.event_identifier || '').toLowerCase().includes('empresa_demohub') ||
    (first.identificador || '').toLowerCase().includes('empresa_demohub');

  if (isempresa_demoHub) {
    return 457;
  }

  const canal =
    (last.conversion_url || '').includes('/contato/')
      ? 'Site'
    : last.conversion_url === 'https://crm.example.com/CONFIGURE_ENDPOINT'
      ? 'LP - XM'
    : last.conversion_url === 'https://crm.example.com/CONFIGURE_ENDPOINT'
      ? 'Site'
    : last.conversion_identifier === 'totem_empresa_demo_lp_lovable'
      ? 'LP - Totem'
    : 'Site';

  const options = [
    { label: "Apollo", id: 395 },
    { label: "Busca Direta", id: 396 },
    { label: "Campaigns", id: 298 },
    { label: "Chatbot", id: 295 },
    { label: "Cliente Base empresa_demo", id: 397 },
    { label: "Cliente Base Track", id: 398 },
    { label: "CONAREC 2024", id: 399 },
    { label: "CX Leadership Summit (CXL) - Out/2024", id: 400 },
    { label: "Effecti - Licitações", id: 419 },
    { label: "E-mail", id: 418 },
    { label: "Facebook Ads", id: 404 },
    { label: "Facebook Orgânico", id: 403 },
    { label: "Feira/Evento", id: 402 },
    { label: "Fusão empresa_demo x Track", id: 405 },
    { label: "Google Ads", id: 406 },
    { label: "Google Orgânico", id: 407 },
    { label: "Indicação", id: 408 },
    { label: "Instagram Ads", id: 410 },
    { label: "Instagram Orgânico", id: 409 },
    { label: "Linkedin Ads", id: 412 },
    { label: "Linkedin Orgânico", id: 411 },
    { label: "Live Chat", id: 296 },
    { label: "LP - Totem", id: 420 },
    { label: "LP - XM", id: 421 },
    { label: "empresa_demohub", id: 457 },
    { label: "Marketplace", id: 299 },
    { label: "Materiais", id: 422 },
    { label: "Messaging Inbox", id: 300 },
    { label: "Não identificado", id: 428 },
    { label: "Parceria", id: 413 },
    { label: "Prospector", id: 292 },
    { label: "Reunião", id: 423 },
    { label: "Site", id: 417 },
    { label: "Teams", id: 424 },
    { label: "Telefone", id: 425 },
    { label: "Webinar", id: 426 },
    { label: "WhatsApp", id: 427 },
    { label: "Whatsapp Track", id: 415 }
  ];

  return options.find(o => o.label === canal)?.id || 417;
})()
}}
